relevance_note: TNFAIP3 is mentioned only as a gene for a disease "leading to A20 haploinsufficiency", and the HA20 description is group-level ("Patients present early in life with oral ulcers, pathergy, dermal abscesses, chorioretinal scarring, and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis."); no identifiable person with a TNFAIP3 variant is described.
method_note: Read the full paper (a review of retinal vasculitis; the only TNFAIP3/HA20 content is one paragraph in 'New insights into pathogenesis' and the reference [12] entry, Zhou Q et al 2016, PMID:26642243). No in-scope person: the HA20 description is a group-level summary of a prior report and gives no sex, age, variant, count or individual feature for anyone, so no individuals, variants, phenotypic_features or phenotype_checklist rows were emitted. Other people named in the paper are out of scope (Figure 1's 25 year-old Saudi male with Behçet's disease, the Behçet's patient treated with prednisone/azathioprine/infliximab, and patients from summarized earlier reports such as refs ^5, ^36, ^37): none has a TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis, and none is a relative of an in-scope person. The 207 patients in 'our own series' are cited to an earlier publication (^3), not to this document, so publications.cohort_size_as_stated was left null. No tables with patients as rows or columns and no stacked cells (' / ') occur in this paper, so D-31 does not apply. No contradictions found. All spans were checked verbatim against the Markdown file.
